MenuItem.title: MenuItem
MenuItem.description: Represents an individual menu item in the restaurant system. Identified uniquely by UUID so items with similar names are never merged or duplicated.

id.description: Unique UUID of the menu item

name.description: Name of the dish or fish item

targetPrinter.description: Assigned target printer (MAIN, KITCHEN_1, KITCHEN_2, or comma-separated)

kitchenName.description: Display name of item on kitchen order tickets

supportsPreparation.description: Whether item supports fish cooking preparation styles

isActive.description: Whether item is currently visible in POS

isPlateWeightEnabled.description: Whether plate weight deduction is active

pricePerKg.description: Price per kg when sold by weight

Category.title: Category
Category.description: Standardized category definition for menu items to avoid duplicate categories across terminals.

color.description: Hex color code for POS tiles

CloudOrder.title: CloudOrder
CloudOrder.description: Synchronized order shared across all terminals. Terminals create orders with PENDING_PRINT status; the master printing device prints and updates status to PRINTED.

orderNumber.description: Unified sequential order number shared across cashier and seller devices

orderType.description: Type of order: TAKEAWAY, DINE_IN, HALL, DELIVERY

status.description: Workflow status: NEW, PENDING, PREPARING, READY, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, COMPLETED, CANCELLED

printStatus.description: Print dispatch status: SAVED_ONLY, PENDING_PRINT, PRINTING, PRINT_REQUESTED, PRINTED, ERROR

requestedPrinterTarget.description: Specific printer target for remote print requests (ALL, MAIN, KITCHEN_1, KITCHEN_2, etc.)

isArchived.description: Whether order is archived across all devices

shiftNumber.description: Work shift sequence number attached to this order

itemsJson.description: Serialized JSON string of order items with quantities, prices, and cooking preparations

createdByTerminal.description: Seller/cashier name who received and created the order

printedByTerminal.description: Identifier of the master terminal that printed the ticket

Terminal.title: Terminal
Terminal.description: Registered cashier or seller device in the restaurant.

name.description: Terminal label e.g. Cashier 1, Waiter Tablet, Master Printer

isMaster.description: True if this terminal holds physical printers

canPrint.description: Whether direct printing is permitted on this device

printerListJson.description: Serialized summary of enabled printers on master cashier for seller remote print buttons

Shift.title: Shift
Shift.description: Shared cashier work shift synced across all terminals.

Counter.title: Counter
Counter.description: Shared sequential counter for unified order numbering across all terminals.

BackupSnapshot.title: BackupSnapshot
BackupSnapshot.description: Complete safe backup snapshot of menu, settings, and orders.

backupName.description: Descriptive name or timestamp label of backup

dataJson.description: Compressed or raw JSON data payload

/users/{userId}/menu_items/{itemId}.description: Master list of menu items shared across all cashier and seller terminals.

/users/{userId}/categories/{categoryId}.description: Standard menu categories to maintain uniformity across all terminals.

/users/{userId}/cloud_orders/{orderId}.description: Active and completed order queue shared between cashier terminals and seller tablets.

/users/{userId}/terminals/{terminalId}.description: Registration of terminals and their printing roles.

/users/{userId}/shifts/{shiftId}.description: Work shifts synced between cashier and seller terminals.

/users/{userId}/counters/{counterId}.description: Shared atomic counters for sequential order numbers.

/users/{userId}/backups/{backupId}.description: Safe cloud backup store for smooth recovery and migration.
